model.external_ports: Finite dimensional input and output ports, unchanged throughout each admitted device.
model.memory: Normal trace-class states on fixed separable type-I tensor-product Hilbert spaces C_A tensor C_B.
model.device: One fixed normal CPTP finite-round finite-outcome LOCC device Lambda.
model.accounting: Every shared register retained between calls is part of the memory. All instrument branches are included. No fresh entanglement is introduced after initialization.
model.reference_input: A faithful product state eta_A tensor eta_B defines Phi by tracing the external outputs.
model.external_process: Complete causal n-slot process, including correlated outputs and adaptive/reference-entangled testers.
model.separability: Trace-norm closed convex hull of normal product states; no assumption of countable decomposability.
model.recurrence: liminf_(t->infinity) ||Phi^t(tau)-tau||_1 = 0. Fixed positive return error is not recurrence.
excluded_extensions: commuting-operator or type-III replacement of the tensor-product model
unaccounted retained branch or stock flags

conventions.output_full_error: nu = ||rho_O-B_D||_1 implies full-block infidelity q <= nu/2
conventions.strategy_distance: Full trace norm on final tester states; d_str(P_n^alpha,P_n^beta) <= ||alpha-beta||_1.

claims.statement: With full initializer/return error epsilon, finite approximant resource R and J n-separated reference-return times: distance(P_n^tau,F_n) <= 2 epsilon + K_n sqrt(2 R/J).

proof.label: thm:finite

claims.scope: Complete causal process. K_n is finite but no useful uniform-horizon or efficient simulation bound is claimed.

claims.statement: For rho_k -> rho in trace norm, finite E_R(rho_k), and vanishing-slack separable relative-entropy near-minimizers gamma_k, the gamma_k are trace-norm relatively compact even without a uniform resource bound.
claims.bound: 1-Tr(P gamma) <= u + sqrt((h_2(u)+u ln(3)+zeta)/2), with P a finite-rank product projection and u=1-Tr(P rho).
load_bearing_points: The canceled block-relative-entropy sum is finite.
The infinite-dimensional pinching identity does not subtract divergent entropies.
Uniform finite-rank tails preserve unit trace and normality at the limit.

claims.statement: Trace-norm recurrence of tau implies one normal separable gamma on the same memory with P_n^gamma=P_n^tau for every finite horizon n under the unchanged device, including E_R(tau)=infinity.
claims.stronger_quantifier: One gamma works simultaneously for every finite horizon; it is not a horizon-dependent sequence of simulators.
claims.additional_corollary: The constructed relatively compact near-minimizer sequence converges to the target process uniformly over finite horizons in strategy distance; this is non-effective.

claims.statement: For J exact Bell outputs and terminal half return delta: E_R(tau) >= J ln(2) sum_(m=1)^N [1-(m-1)delta]_+ - ln(N), for all N>=1.

claims.correlations: Uses the full joint output and first-failure transcript. Global Bell tests are analytical data-processing tests, not free LOCC postselection.
claims.noisy_extension: R >= J ln(2) sum_(m=1)^N [1-q-xi/2-(m-1)(delta+q)]_+ - ln(N+1). Here q is whole-block infidelity and xi is full initializer approximation error.

matching_construction.state: tau_(J,L)=(1/L) sum_(k=J)^(J+L-1) [B^tensor k tensor C^tensor(M-k)], M=J+L-1, C=(|00><00|+|11><11|)/2.
matching_construction.fixed_device: Release the first cell, shift, and append C using one shared unbiased bit. A direct sum over finite lengths implements the whole family without measuring the length sector.
matching_construction.retained_registers: The deterministic length sector M is counted. The random stock label K is discarded before initialization, not retained covertly.
matching_construction.return: For each 1<=j<=J, complete-memory half trace <= j/L. L=ceil(J/delta) meets every-use return.
matching_construction.preparation_expected_bell_pairs: J+(L-1)/2 for the explicit classical sampler
matching_construction.preparation_maximum_bell_pairs: M=J+L-1 for the explicit classical sampler
matching_construction.useful_call_consumption: Exactly one ebit per exact Bell output; E_R(tau_j)=E_R(tau)-j ln(2) for j<=J.
matching_construction.depletion: After M calls the memory is C^tensor M and does not recur to the entangled initial state.
matching_construction.support: Finite occupied sector for every fixed J,delta; increasing occupied support as delta->0.
matching_construction.consequence: Matching intrinsic-resource asymptotics; no renewable capability or preparation-cost advantage established.

unresolved_and_allocation.scientifically_consequential_operation: Noisy complete-stream delivery with specified whole-block quality, finite occupied memory, all-use return and an operational preparation budget.
unresolved_and_allocation.precise_gap: The noisy first-failure bound has no matching joint optimum established here, and intrinsic E_R does not identify actual one-shot formation cost.
unresolved_and_allocation.reopening_condition: A specified quantum operation whose accepted conclusion depends on the unresolved noisy-output or formation-cost question.
